build_pcr_pipeline: build a PCR pipeline using StandardScaler, PCA with 1 component, and LinearRegression
build_pls_regressor: build a PLS regressor with 1 component and fit it on training data
split_data_train_test: split dataset X and target y into train and test sets with random state
transform_and_predict: transform test data with PLS and predict target values
score_regressor: score a fitted regressor on test data to compute R-squared
